description_en: Updates the feature information of an environment
kebab_example: aliyun arms upgrade-environment-feature --environment-id env-xxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --feature-name metric-agent --feature-version 1.1.17 --values PodAnnotation_:_run --aliyun-lang zh --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeEnvironmentFeature

parameters.description_en: The feature name. Valid values: app-agent-pilot, metric-agent, ebpf-agent, and service-check.
parameters.description_zh: Feature的名称 app-agent-pilot | metric-agent | ebpf-agent | service-check。
parameters.help_en: The feature name. Valid values: app-agent-pilot, metric-agent, ebpf-agent, and service-check
parameters.help_zh: Feature的名称 app-agent-pilot | metric-agent | ebpf-agent | service-check
parameters.name: feature_name

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to enable service discovery. For PodAnnotation, set the value to run or mini. For PodMonitor and ServiceMonitor, set the value to true or false.
parameters.description_zh: 开关服务发现用, PodAnnotation | PodMonitor | ServiceMonitor, PodAnnotation开关是run和mini, pm和sm则传 true和false, 例如 {"PodAnnotation":"run"}。
